description: Repairs r-sort-3b/image-drop-rebuild: the intermediate files[...] captures were size-only (unread: IOException 0x80070020, file in use), so the images after drop, rebuild, delete and reinsert were not retained; the statements ran with no options. New General ACCDB. T(ID Long primary key, K TEXT(40)) with the first 24 pair-corpus values. Each of these steps is its own read/write open of the closed file with dbFailOnError, DBEngine.Errors after each statement and an image kept after the close: CREATE INDEX IX_K ON T (K); DROP INDEX IX_K; CREATE INDEX IX_K again; DROP IX_K and CREATE as IX_K2; copy the even IDs to TB and DELETE them from T; INSERT the even IDs again in descending ID order; CREATE INDEX IX_KD ON T (K DESC). The IX_K walk is read after the first build and after the rebuild, the IX_K2 walk after the reinsert and the IX_KD walk after the last step (each in the same open, before the close), with the refreshed index metadata at the end. Asks what drop, rebuild, delete and reinsert change in the file and whether a rebuilt or maintained index lists ties in the same order as the original build.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-fmt-sort probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.

CREATE TABLE TB (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_TB PRIMARY KEY, K TEXT(40))
